capability: Agent memory flags clashes for a person, never overwrites
title: Keep both. Mark the join.

hook.picture: Close: a pod writes a new note card onto the memory line, right on top of an older card. The old card is pushed under the line and sinks.
hook.words: It remembered. Just the wrong thing.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The assistant replaced what my client said in March.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: a consultant using an AI assistant with memory

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the memory line is a stack of cards. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a new card lands on an old one and the old one sinks.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: New notes land on top of old ones.

stakes.body: The assistant answers confidently from the newest note, and the client's real words are lost.

solution_hint: Keep both. Ask a person which holds.

metaphor.body: Memory is a line of cards. A new card that disagrees with an old one lands beside it, joined by a glowing seam, and a tick goes to a person instead of the old card sinking.

steps.picture: The new card lands beside the old one, not on top. A dashed join links them; they disagree, so the join glows copper.
steps.words: Keep both. Ask a person which holds.
steps.sound: Two tones, old and new, beating.

steps.picture: A tick card floats from the copper join to the whale, now the person. The pod is held: two answers, not settled yet.
steps.words: Clashes go to a person, not a guess.
steps.sound: A soft ping as the tick arrives.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale reads both cards, keeps the March one as current and files the new one with a note. The join turns teal. Both cards stay on the line.
steps.words: You decide. Both stay on record.

steps.picture: Labels slide on: the join is a seam, the copper glow is discord.
steps.words: A lit seam means discord. Shown, not hidden.
steps.sound: Beating pair, then unison, once more.

real_case.claim: From the design, not a run: the memory system glues locally consistent sections, and per-edge discord flags conflicts for human review. Consistency is not truth.

honest_limit.picture: Push to the queue: ticks pile up faster than the whale clears them. The oldest tick fades, still unread, while the pod keeps answering.
honest_limit.words: Nobody reads the queue. Clashes wait forever.

not_this.body: Flagging a clash is not deciding it.

ending_pattern.body: The overwritten card rises back from under the line, takes its place beside the new one, and the assistant answers correctly from it.
ending_pattern.callback: The card that sank under the line in bar 1 rises back in the same framing and is answered from.

end_belief.body: Never let memory write over. Show the clash.

score_self.reason: Overwritten AI memory is a fresh and widely felt pain, and the limit (an unread queue) is a real operational edge. The case is a design, not a run, so it is marked Illustration.
